summary.description: Hydrogen cyanide is a colourless, flammable gas with an almond-like odour that is potentially explosive in contact with air.
emission_sources: Use in industrial applications such as manufacture of organic chemicals for synthetic fibres and plastics
Natural small releases from some plants
environmental_impact: Toxic to fish and aquatic life
Rapidly evaporates from water and soil, not persistent in environment
Can leach into groundwater and affects respiration, impacting brain and cardiovascular system at high exposure

top_sdg_impacts.SDG3_Good_Health_and_Wellbeing: Hydrogen cyanide is highly toxic to humans at high concentrations, affecting respiration, brain function, and cardiovascular health.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG6_Clean_Water_and_Sanitation: The pollutant contaminates water sources, can leach into groundwater, and affects the safety of clean water supplies.
top_sdg_impacts.SDG14_Life_Below_Water: Hydrogen cyanide is toxic to aquatic life and can negatively impact fish and other water organisms.
